_ghi_chu: File mau cau hinh MCP chatgpt-image cho Antigravity. Bo muc _ghi_chu nay khi chep vao file that.
File that: .agents/mcp_config.json trong du an, hoac ~/.gemini/config/mcp_config.json cho moi du an.
Thay C:\Users\TEN-MAY\Documents\chatgpt-image-mcp bang duong dan thu muc chatgpt-image-mcp tren may ban. Trong JSON, moi dau \ phai viet thanh \\.
macOS: thay bang dang /Users/TEN-MAY/Documents/chatgpt-image-mcp (dau / giu nguyen).
Antigravity bao khong tim thay uv: thay chu uv o command bang duong dan day du, Windows: C:\Users\TEN-MAY\.local\bin\uv.exe, macOS: /Users/TEN-MAY/.local/bin/uv.
--directory bao uv chay trong thu muc repo, thay cho truong cwd trong README cua repo.
timeoutSeconds: 300 giay cho moi lan goi tool, vi tao anh mat 30 toi 90 giay, mac dinh Antigravity la 180 giay.
